clk_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin you have the CLK line hooked up to.

*See also: [TM1638 7 Segment Display Keypad & LED Module](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1638#configuration-variables)*

dio_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin you have the DIO line hooked up to.

*See also: [TM1638 7 Segment Display Keypad & LED Module](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1638#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [TM1638 7 Segment Display Keypad & LED Module](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1638#configuration-variables)*

intensity.docs:
**int**: The intensity with which the TM1638 should drive the outputs. Range is from 0 (least intense) to 7 (the default). This setting will affect the 7 segment display and the 8 individual LED lights.

*See also: [TM1638 7 Segment Display Keypad & LED Module](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1638#configuration-variables)*

stb_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin you have the STB line hooked up to.

*See also: [TM1638 7 Segment Display Keypad & LED Module](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1638#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to re-draw the screen. Defaults to `1s`.

*See also: [TM1638 7 Segment Display Keypad & LED Module](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1638#configuration-variables)*

lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: The lambda to use for rendering the content on the TM1638. See [Rendering Lambda](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1638#display-tm1638_lambda) for more information.

*See also: [TM1638 7 Segment Display Keypad & LED Module](https://esphome.io/components/display/tm1638#configuration-variables)*
